name: Yuuguredoki no Setsu-nyan
original_name: 夕暮れ刻のセツにゃん
source:
Setsuna is a cat shaped android. He gets picked up by Lockon. But things get confusing when another person looking just like Lockon appears!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Setsuna是一个猫形机器人。他被洛克恩接走了。但当另一个长得像洛克恩的人出现时，事情就变得混乱了！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
